name: zEnv
description: A zero-knowledge secret manager with client-side encryption. Includes a Go API, TypeScript SDK, Cobra CLI, and TanStack Start dashboard featuring a custom crypto engine.
features: Engineered an end-to-end zero-knowledge secret management platform utilizing AES-256-GCM and Argon2 encryption.
Built a high-throughput, self-hostable Go backend to manage encrypted secrets and team-based RBAC.
Developed a native CLI tool for zero-friction CI/CD secret injection, paired with a modern TanStack Start dashboard featuring a custom client-side crypto engine.
